paragraphs: Rabbi Abba of Caesarea. Ta'anit (76b [as printed; Ta'anit has no such folio]); another reading: Rabbi Zeira of Caesarea. At the end of Mo'ed Katan he recited a teaching before Rabbi Yochanan. See there (20b): Rabbi Adda of Caesarea (see there). See below, Rabbi Abba son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, who was in Caesarea. Perhaps the Abba or Adda mentioned above are one, with an error in one of the names. She'erit Yosef lists both among Rabbi Yochanan’s students; this requires examination. See below, Rabbi Abbahu, for he was in Caesarea.
